summary: Preserve strict-mode this semantics when a class method is extracted and called without a receiver.

target.notes: Represent the method as a JavaScript function value carrying its [[HomeObject]] where needed but not automatically binding the original receiver. Ordinary detached calls supply undefined as this.

caveats: A C# delegate created from an instance method normally captures the receiver, which is the opposite of JavaScript method extraction semantics.

tests.name: detached method gets undefined this
tests.input: class C { m(){ return this; } } const f=new C().m; console.log(f()===undefined);

tests.name: edge: bind changes receiver explicitly
tests.input: class C { m(){ return this.x; } } const f=new C().m.bind({x:5}); console.log(f());
